research.name: pgtui
research.note: Terminal client for PostgreSQL with a schema tree, tabbed table views, a JSONB tree viewer and a Ctrl+K command palette.

effects: JSONB tree viewer overlay with type-colored values and a live JSON path readout for the selected key
Ctrl+K command palette overlay searching commands, tables and query history with >, @ and # modes
lazygit-style layout: explorer tree of schemas and tables beside tabbed Data/Columns/Constraints/Indexes views with a key-hint footer
